description: This Java class implements a Runnable task for downloading image bytes from a URL, managing download states, handling interruptions, and communicating with a PhotoTask object through a defined interface.

classes.name: PhotoDownloadRunnable
classes.description: A Runnable class that downloads image bytes from a URL, manages download states, and communicates with a PhotoTask object.

classes.name: PhotoDownloadRunnable.TaskRunnableDownloadMethods
classes.description: An interface defining methods for setting thread info, managing byte buffers, handling download states, and retrieving the image URL, implemented by PhotoTask.

methods.name: PhotoDownloadRunnable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the runnable with a reference to the PhotoTask implementing TaskRunnableDownloadMethods.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the download process: sets thread priority, checks for interruptions, opens HTTP connection, reads image data into buffer, updates download state, and handles cleanup.
